question_pt: Quando houver dados socioeconômicos, como a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar em 2021 varia por quintil de leitos SUS por mil habitantes?
sql: WITH mun AS (SELECT s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000", NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000") AS quintil_leitos FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021 AND s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000" IS NOT NULL), adm AS (SELECT "MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES") SELECT quintil_leitos, COUNT(*) AS municipios, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM mun LEFT JOIN adm ON mun."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = adm.municipio_codigo GROUP BY quintil_leitos ORDER BY quintil_leitos
